additional_info.subject: ID0477751-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P9 170000920] Multiple error CRM:02681001428
additional_info.body:
Dear Bjoern ,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support, I hope this email finds you well.
After check all the information you shared with us and check the logs I can inform you:
• (
secc pilot is E
) is the state of outlet during a charging session, so it can show in some sessions just as information.
On the screenshot we can see on the log showing
cabledisconnected 2
After this we can see the OCPP sending the information to your side
• The error regarding the "
Error on LEM
" was on the last year for 2 hours but after the error regarding Sync status shows true it was the charger solved itself
• The information "
secc is offline"
is regarding a delay on the connection
That is also fixed after it become stable again
Please let me know if you require any further assistance, or if we may proceed with closing this ticket
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
